'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 2 Brian Fred LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Fred]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
